argv: set -e; R=$HOME/.local/share/bridge-comand-bootstrap; if [ ! -d "$R/.git" ]; then git clone https://github.com/One-Wave-Universe/Bridge-Comand.git "$R"; fi; git -C "$R" fetch origin main; git -C "$R" checkout --detach origin/main; ONE_WAVE_PROJECT_ROOT=/home/Scales/One-Wave-Science bash "$R/hive-pipe/install_independent_bootstrap.sh"; systemctl --user start one-wave-bootstrap.service || true; cat "$HOME/.local/state/one-wave-bootstrap/last-run.json"
intention: Install the independent Jetson boot recovery anchor so bridge listeners can recover without Desktop Commander or an already-running Hive Pipe route.
consequence: Creates/enables only user-level One-Wave bootstrap service/timer, repairs bridge services through existing bounded installers, and returns its FIELD/VOID receipt.
